judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A decent sky photo with interesting cloud texture but held back by dull lighting and a weak composition.
strengths: distinct cloud texture in mid-level layers
subtle color variation in the sky
weaknesses: composition feels unbalanced with tower in corner
